Lebensgrosse Dinosauriermodelle vom Tyrannosaurus Rex bis zum Ichthyosaurus am Triassic Trail

kurzbeschreibung: Triassic Park on the Steinplatte Waidring whisks families away to prehistoric times with life-sized dinosaurs, a coral platform, and a water beach.
beschreibung:
Dino Adventure on the Alps' Ancient Coral Reef

On the Steinplatte in Waidring, visitors at Triassic Park dive straight into the prehistoric era of the dinosaurs. Where massive cliff walls tower today, the ancient Tethys Sea stretched out 200 million years ago. Along the Triassic Trail, hikers encounter true-to-life dinosaurs in original size.

Prehistoric Beach and Adrenaline Rush

At Triassic Beach at over 1,600 meters above sea level, children can dig in the sand and splash through the water labyrinth. For pure thrill, the cantilevered coral-shaped viewing platform hovers 70 meters directly above a sheer vertical abyss.
